ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The hall's rate categories are 8 hours and 12 hours; no 24-hour rate is set (shown as "-" in the price list). Extending before or after the booking incurs a same-day extension fee (in 30-minute units; the unit price differs between 7:00-22:00 and 22:00-7:00 the next morning), and night-time use or extensions may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. The official FAQ says "Except for some venues, the venues can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year." Advance receipt of packages is in principle for arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the load-in date (valuables are not accepted, and the operator is not responsible for damage to packages). Large or heavy items arriving without prior notice are treated as renting the venue as a storage space, for a fee. Sudden layout changes on the day before the planned use or during the usage period cannot be requested from the operator. (Source: Hall price list updated July 3, 2026, FAQ, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 20)
ops.loadingHours: When there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Loading and unloading work is in principle limited to 20 minutes. Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave within the usage time from the designated place, and the venue may adjust load-in times and the like. The hall is loaded on the B1F and the conference room from "Loading Area B" on the B1F. The hall's load-in door is 3,000 mm wide x 3,200 mm high, the entrance door is 1,200 mm wide x 2,300 mm high, and the load-in/out elevator measures 1,800 mm wide x 2,900 mm high x 2,300 mm deep inside the car, with a load capacity of 2,700 kg. The facility page says "the approach from the underground loading space to the Event Hall is flat, and vehicles can also be brought in through the 3,000 mm wide load-in entrance." The on-site manager must complete entry procedures at the Service Center on the 1F of Iidabashi First Tower before work, and report completion and complete exit procedures afterward. The building entrance is open on weekdays 7:00-21:00. Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes for the hall and 2 boxes per room. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice (Event Hall / Rental Conference Rooms), Event Hall and Conference Room equipment lists updated September 28, 2026, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking, parking outside the designated parking lot, and roadside parking around the building are strictly prohibited. The loading area gives priority to Event Hall users (Terms of Use). Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. The permitted dimensions of the loading area (underground) are 3,200 mm in total height x 6,000 mm in length (Advance Load-in Notice). The vehicle limits in the equipment lists are 3,200 mm in height x 6,000 mm in length and 3.0 t in weight for the hall, and the same dimensions with 4.0 t for the conference room, so the weight figures do not agree. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15, 16 and 21, Event Hall and Conference Room equipment lists updated September 28, 2026)
ops.parking: In the hall equipment list, the parking column shows Bellesalle-exclusive parking as "available (3 vehicles can be left)", hourly parking as "none", and the drop-off area as behind the 1F entrance. In the conference room equipment list, both Bellesalle-exclusive parking and hourly parking are "none". On the other hand, the official FAQ lists Iidabashi First as a facility where "the building that houses the facility has an hourly parking lot (number of spaces is limited)", and each venue's detail page also shows "hourly parking available", which does not agree with the equipment list. To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Iidabashi First" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Event Hall and Conference Room equipment lists updated September 28, 2026, FAQ, official facility page)
ops.waitingRooms: The hall has 4 waiting rooms: Waiting Room 1 at 11㎡, Waiting Room 2 at 18㎡, Waiting Room 3 at 16㎡ and Waiting Room 4 at 38㎡ (83㎡ in total). All have a usage fee of 0 yen, and waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. The hall has a ceiling-mounted fixed camera, so you can follow the progress of the event on the waiting room monitors. The facility page says waiting rooms with routes designed with VIPs and visitors in mind are available. The conference room equipment list shows waiting rooms as "none". (Source: Event Hall equipment list updated September 28, 2026, official facility page)
ops.catering: If a caterer other than the designated vendors is used to arrange food and drink, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 4)
ops.restaurants: The official FAQ says party menus suited to receptions are available, and details can be found in the menu section of the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: FAQ)
